verdict.rationale: Mirrors works with existing traces and lets teams review sessions against outcome labels. It can preview routing conditions against stored traces (matches, misses, unexpected matches), which is a limited offline check. Its main evaluation is an online holdout comparison of live sessions, not offline evals run over curated datasets. Missing for 10: explicit dataset curation or export from production traces, offline evaluation runs scoring agent outputs against a dataset, eval docs or API, and independent corroboration.
